name: Relic of Progenitus
description: An eye-shaped pendant in Eleni's hair, reminiscent of the elvish monument to Progenitus, which destroys the undead wurm when she shouts its command word.

description_citations.work: A Different Kind of Origin Story
description_citations.text: "A Different Kind of Origin Story". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Jun 2009. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: The narrator tells Eleni to use the relic of Progenitus and she shouts a command word, disintegrating the wurm.
timeline.quote: The wurm disintegrated in a mass of smoking ash, billowing apart as the lava consumed it.
